entries.summary: The Control API can now read and edit your favorites, routes, and speed profiles, and it accepts movement and state commands. The wiki has the full reference.
The side menu now links to the Acknowledgements page, which credits the projects this app uses.
Moving the joystick now pauses a walk, route, or roam instead of ending it, so you can resume it afterward. The widget also shows more clearly which state it is in.
The debug stats readout now opens in a small popup beside the widget instead of covering it. The Tap to Walk cancel button now works with TalkBack.
Compass orientation now retries up to three times when it cannot read your heading. The Accessibility explanation now appears on its own during first-run setup.
The light theme has stronger contrast for accents, errors, warnings, outlines, and the top-bar toggle, so text and controls are easier to see.
External links in the side menu are no longer read twice by TalkBack.
